title: Automated quality probes for model promotions and customer pins
creator: Arianna Patel
description: Goal: Implement an event-driven probe system that runs lightweight, targeted evals whenever a model version is promoted in the catalog or when a customer pins/ upgrades a model. Unlike broad post-hoc benchmarking, this ticket covers a staged probe workflow: (1) small synthetic probes against a prioritized subset of prompts, (2) a sampling cohort for the customer tenant (if customer-pinned), and (3) a short follow-up stability window where signals are aggregated and compared against baseline. The system should surface both quality regressions (fidelity, hallucination rate, instruction-following drops) and operational regressions (latency, token cost) and attach an automated verdict to the pin/promotion event for downstream automation (notify, require manual approval, or trigger rollback). Scope: hook into model-promotion and tenant-pin events, run probes with configurable budgets, compute delta metrics, store probe results in the eval store, surface findings in the Console prompt-level diffs, and emit evaluation webhooks/alerts. Out of scope: full-scale catalog re-benchmarking, long-term continuous monitoring (handled by separate monitoring pipelines).
acceptance_criteria: On catalog model promotion, a probe job is scheduled automatically within 5 minutes and runs against the curated probe set for that model family.
For customer-pinned upgrades, the system runs a tenant-scoped probe sample (configurable sampling rate; default 1%) that uses that tenant's routed prompts where available or a fallback probe set.

Probe results compute a standardized delta report (metrics: accuracy/fidelity proxy, hallucination percentage, prompt-response similarity via embeddings, median latency, token-cost delta) and persist to the evals store with a searchable tag linking to the promotion/pin event.

If any metric exceeds configurable thresholds, the event is marked with a Quality Flag and the Console shows a red alert with suggested remediation (disable rollout, require manual review, or auto-rollback if enabled).
APIs: expose a REST endpoint to fetch last probe result for a given model version or tenant pin; expose webhook/event payload that contains verdict and metric deltas.
System respects probe budget and RBAC: probe jobs cannot exceed configured GPU/call budgets and tenant probes honor tenant privacy (no data exfiltration).
tasks: Design probe sampling policy (catalog probe set vs tenant-sampled cohort) and default budgets
Define metrics, scoring formulas, and verdict thresholds with Research/Applied ML
Implement promotion/pin event hook and job dispatcher in orchestration service
Add probe job runner to eval-worker with optimized lightweight runners (short timeouts, truncated generation)
Wire results into eval-store schema and index by event-id and model-version
Console: surface probe results on model-version and tenant pin pages, include drilldowns to prompt-level diffs
Webhook: implement evaluation webhook and allow integration with alerting rules
Add e2e test harness and a canary pipeline with synthetic promotions
success_metrics: >90% of catalog promotions trigger a probe and report within SLA (10 minutes)
False positive rate for automatic rollback decisions < 5% in first 90 days
Mean time to surface a regression <= 15 minutes after promotion/pin
Reduction in customer-reported post-upgrade regressions by 60% in first quarter after rollout
